lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You lean in, hands outstretched to scoop up the feline. But in a blur of fur and sheer defiance, the cat vanishes and reappearing in the far corner of the room before you can even blink. A masterful escape. He’s not half bad, this one.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: A second attempt. You feel the sweet surge of success victory practically tingling in your fingertips—but the cat... well, the cat has other plans. With a flick of its tail, it simply vanishes, only to manifest in the opposite corner once more. Teleportation? Or just a very, very skilled feline?

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: After a brief, spirited chase, the cat loses all semblance of interest in you. She curls up and drifts into a slumber. A victory for you, then? Or simply... performance? Perhaps she merely let you win to quiet your persistence. Who truly knows what lies behind those yellow eyes?
